commons.title: Makuna shaman and his disciple.png
commons.credit: Richard Evans Schultes, Robert Francis Raffauf
commons.description:
A Makuna shaman and his disciple, dancing around a sick young man, diagnose the cause of the illness with the help of hallucinogenic drugs. Photo from Richard Evans Schultes, Robert Francis Raffauf.
“La selva sanadora:plantas medicinales y tóxicas del noroeste del Amazonas”, Revista de Estudios Sociales, 32 | 2009, 126-143.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption specifically identifies Makuna people, and the image visibly shows traditional feathered headdresses and ritual dancing/performance.
